title: Mumbai Metro just crossed 300 million passenger journeys
sources: Free Press Journal - MMRDA Metro Network Crosses 300 Million Passenger Journeys
Swarajya - Mumbai Metro crosses 300 million passenger journeys, sets fastest growth record
caption:
Mumbai Metro just crossed 300 million passenger journeys. And the last 50 million came faster than ever before.

Mumbai's metro network hit 300 million cumulative passenger journeys on August 3, 2026, across four lines, according to the MMRDA. The last 50 million journeys came in just 179 days - the fastest growth in the network's history. Average daily ridership additions have climbed to nearly 2.79 lakh journeys, credited largely to new lines opened in April 2026 that added nine stations.

A new transit system usually gets slower to adopt as it ages. Mumbai Metro's growth is accelerating instead.

Sources: Free Press Journal, Swarajya (2026)
